mapper.insert: MERGE INTO visit_log target USING ( SELECT #{memberNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS member_no, #{sessionId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS session_id, #{requestUri, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS request_uri, #{queryString, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS query_string, #{requestMethod, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS request_method, #{userAgent, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS user_agent, #{ipAddress, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS ip_address, #{referer, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS referer, SYSTIMESTAMP AS created_date FROM dual ) source ON ( target.ip_address = source.ip_address AND TRUNC(CAST(target.created_date AS DATE)) = TRUNC(CAST(source.created_date AS DATE)) ) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( member_no, session_id, request_uri, query_string, request_method, user_agent, ip_address, referer, created_date ) VALUES ( source.member_no, source.session_id, source.request_uri, source.query_string, source.request_method, source.user_agent, source.ip_address, source.referer, source.created_date )
